description: Analysis of the last 130 ppm gap after spectral correction. If lw = 5/2 + 3h²/4 + c₄h⁴ with c₄ ≈ √3/10 (0.20% off exact), m_p = 938.272 MeV at 0.4 ppm. But: c₄ = √3/10 is FITTING, not derived. The exact c₄ = 0.17286 is the propagation of all q-dependent factors through the mass formula chain. Not a simple Habiro or Wedderburn sum.

data.status: FITTING — √3/10 is a near-miss, not a derivation
